page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.re6p.2xlarge delivers average multi-core and memory performance. The Passmark CPU score of 8301.57 and Geekbench multi-core score of 4501.0 place it in the middle tier of tested instances. However, single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by a stress-ng single-core score of 1317.89 and a weak single-threaded gzip compression rate of 22.74 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth remains stable, measuring 392.37 GB/sec for cached small blocks and approximately 50.74 GB/sec for uncached large blocks.

The lack of local storage and modest 2 Gbps network baseline are key architectural tradeoffs to consider for I/O-intensive operations. While the instance supports advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and AES for cryptographic operations, its weak single-threaded execution and lower Redis SET throughput of 6.88 million operations per second suggest it is less suited for high-frequency transactional databases. It is best utilized for general-purpose workloads, moderate web serving, software compilation, and applications requiring dedicated CPU allocation without extreme storage performance demands.
